What’s the difference between an electrical contractor and an electrician? “Licensed electrical contractors” are people or companies that employ electricians. “Licensed electricians” are individual tradesmen with the training and experience to do the actual work. So, you may hire a licensed electrical contractor to rewire your house, but you should see licensed electricians doing the work. The same goes for plumbing
